Team —

Quick context: our annual SOC 2 renewal window opens in late Mar; we need a firm selected and a signed SOW by mid-March to keep the audit timeline. Our incumbent (BrightSeal) submitted a proposal but pricing is up ~12% vs last year. We ran an informal outreach and have a competitive quote from ClearAssurance that looks competitive on price and timing.

Goals for this thread:
- Align on evaluation criteria (security scope, evidence collection support, timeline, liability/contract terms).
- Decide whether to pursue incumbent renewal negotiation or move to ClearAssurance.
- Agree who will lead vendor negotiations and legal handoff.

I've attached the RFP we sent (Redwood_RFP_SOC2_2026.pdf) and a one-tab scoring rubric (I'll send spreadsheet separately). Please reply with: 
1) any non-negotiable scope items from security/compliance (Monica)
2) procurement/contract constraints (Laura & Rishi)
3) commercial tolerance / how far we push on price (Marissa)

Recommend: Karthik to lead commercial negotiation, Monica to confirm technical scope & evidence timeline, Laura to shepherd contract terms.

Thanks — short replies fine.

— Karthik

Karthik — quick technical constraints / non-negotiables for vendor selection: 
1) Vendor must support review of KMS/HSM configuration and provide signed evidence that testers had appropriate access during observation windows. No exceptions — this is required for our controls.
2) Vendor evidence portal must support SFTP or a SOC-compliant upload flow; no unencrypted email for evidence transfers.
3) Vendor must be able to produce SOC-related artifacts from the prior year within 48 hours on request (e.g., previous gap remediation trackers, working papers).
4) We need a firm timeline: kickoff by 03/10 at latest to meet our release schedule.

If BrightSeal cannot commit to 1 & 2 in writing and confirm kickoff timeline, we should move to ClearAssurance. Laura / Rishi, please confirm contractual checkpoints you need; I want legal review window to be at least 3 business days after we receive the draft SOW.

Attachment: Redwood_RFP_SOC2_2026.pdf

— Monica
